title: Step 1 - Applicant details, as the customer first opens the link
text: Title, name, nationality and date of birth are already filled by Sales (the customer can change them). Only one applicant is shown; Spouse and Passport / bank panels are folded away.

title: Step 1 - what happens if something required is empty
text: A list "Still missing on this page" appears at the top, each item jumps to its box, and the box turns red. Nothing is lost.

title: Step 1 - filled, with the two folded panels opened
text: Spouse & anniversary and Passport & bank details are hidden until the customer taps them (passport & bank open by themselves for a foreign applicant).

title: Step 1 - a joint applicant added
text: "+ Add another applicant" adds a full block (up to 6). Joint applicants do not ask for date of birth or spouse. Each has a Remove button.

title: Step 1 - a foreign / NRI applicant (third applicant)
text: Choosing another nationality makes PAN optional, flags the country with its flag, and opens the Passport & bank details panel as required.

title: Step 2 - Contact & address, as opened
text: Mobile, email and contact person are pre-filled by Sales. The residential address is for the customer. The Office address is a switch that stays folded.

title: Step 2 - with an office address and a different permanent address
text: Switching on "I want to add an office address" opens its fields and adds Office as a choice for letters. Choosing Other for mailing / permanent address opens a box for it.

title: Step 3 - Occupation & source, as opened
text: Everything here is optional except "Other" (if chosen). "More about you" is folded away.

title: Step 3 - "More about you" opened, "Other" source, several reasons
text: Choosing Other for "how did you hear" opens a required box. "Why did you choose this project?" takes up to 5 reasons, each can be removed.

title: Step 4 - Unit details, as opened
text: Block, floor, flat number, bedrooms, car park, built-up area and total price are pre-filled by Sales ("As agreed with our sales team") - the customer can still change them. Home loan is No.

title: Step 4 - Home loan "Yes" opens the bank box
text: The preferred bank box appears only when a loan is wanted.

title: Step 5 - Booking amount, paid by UPI / NEFT / RTGS
text: Amount in figures and in words, date paid, UTR reference, bank. Purpose and "Booked through" below. (Sales person name and Lead ID are hidden for now.)

title: Step 5 - paid by cheque
text: The labels change (Cheque number, Cheque date) and Bank (drawn on) becomes required with a Branch box.

title: Step 6 - KYC documents, nothing attached yet
text: One card per applicant (named), a PAN box and an Aadhaar box. A foreign applicant's boxes are optional.

title: Step 6 - photos attached (two photos for one Aadhaar)
text: Each box takes up to 2 files (photo or PDF) - e.g. Aadhaar front and back. Thumbnails show, with a × to remove. Files are saved the moment they are attached.

title: Step 7 - Terms & signature, before reading
text: The three term lists are folded ("Open each section to read it in full"). The tick box and the signature box are both required.

title: Step 7 - a term list opened
text: Tapping a heading opens the numbered clauses.

title: Step 7 - ticked and signed
text: The first applicant signs in the box (mouse or finger). "Sign again" clears it. Only the first applicant signs.

title: Step 8 - Review & submit
text: Everything the customer gave, section by section, with an Edit button for each (it returns straight to this page after the change). Empty items are hidden.

title: Closing the page and opening the link again
text: The customer lands on the same step with every answer, attached file and signature still there (saved on our server as they typed).

title: After Submit - thank-you screen
text: The customer gets a reference number. The form is sent to Sales ("Generated forms").

title: The link opened again after submitting
text: Shown read-only, exactly as submitted. PAN and Aadhaar show only their last four characters; passport and bank say "Provided"; no document is shown.

title: Sales / Administrator preview of a submitted form (signed in)
text: The same page, but for staff: every answer including full PAN / Aadhaar numbers, the documents as picture cards under each applicant's name, and the signature. Only what the customer gave - nothing else.

title: Sales preview - a document opened large
text: Tap a card to see the picture large; the applicant's name is shown with it.
